texts.text: Every box must stay at least 1.5 seconds in the inspection zone before it crosses into packing.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry must have dwelled continuously in the inspection zone for at least 1500 ms before that crossing.

assumptions: Crossing into packing is interpreted as CROSSES packing_entry with direction to_left, per given mapping that rightward (+x) motion is to_left and boxes travel left to right.
Stay at least 1.5 seconds is interpreted as DWELL in inspection for >=1500 ms continuously.
DWELL allows any motion (max_speed null), not only stopped, since stillness is not stated.
BEFORE has no maximum gap (within_ms null); the dwell may occur any time before the first packing crossing.
Boxes that never cross packing_entry pass vacuously via IMPLIES.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box must dwell continuously for at least 1500 ms in the inspection zone before crossing packing_entry to_left into packing.

assumptions: 'Stay at least 1.5 seconds' is interpreted as continuous DWELL in 'inspection' for at least 1500 ms with any motion (max_speed=null).
Crossing into packing is a left-to-right/rightward (+x) crossing of 'packing_entry', which per the line definition is direction 'to_left'.
No maximum interval between the dwell and the crossing is specified, so BEFORE uses within_ms=null.
Boxes that never cross into packing pass vacuously via the IMPLIES idiom.

texts.text: Every box must stop in the inspection zone for at least 1.5 seconds before it crosses into packing.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry rightwards must have previously dwelled stopped in the inspection zone for at least 1500 ms.

assumptions: Crossing into packing is interpreted as CROSSES line 'packing_entry' in direction 'to_left', since rightwards (+x) is defined as to_left and boxes travel left to right.
Stop is interpreted as DWELL with max_speed 0.05, meaning continuously stopped/still inside the zone.
1.5 seconds is converted to 1500 ms of continuous dwell in zone 'inspection'.
No maximum time gap is imposed between the dwell and the crossing (within_ms null); the dwell must simply precede the first packing crossing.
Boxes that never cross into packing pass vacuously via IMPLIES.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box must have a stopped dwell in inspection for at least 1.5s before crossing packing_entry in the to_left (left-to-right) direction

assumptions: 'Stop' is interpreted as a continuous DWELL in zone 'inspection' for at least 1500 ms with max_speed 0.05 (stopped/still)
1.5 seconds is converted to 1500 milliseconds
Crossing into packing is crossing line 'packing_entry' left-to-right (+x), which the provided mapping labels as direction 'to_left'
No maximum time between the inspection dwell and the packing crossing is specified, so BEFORE has within_ms null
Boxes that never cross into packing pass, following IMPLIES(OCCURS(crossing), BEFORE(dwell, crossing))
BEFORE uses its first/then event fields with no children, as required by validation

texts.text: Every box must wait at least 1.5 seconds in the inspection zone before it crosses into packing.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry to the left must have first dwelled stopped in inspection for at least 1500 ms.

assumptions: Crossing into packing means CROSSES packing_entry in direction to_left, which per the line description corresponds to rightwards left-to-right travel.
'wait' means stopped, so DWELL uses max_speed 0.05 for stopped/still.
'at least 1.5 seconds' means continuously inside for min_ms 1500.
No maximum gap between the wait and the crossing is required, so within_ms is null.
Boxes that never cross packing_entry vacuously pass via IMPLIES.
'Wait at least 1.5 seconds' is interpreted as continuously dwelling in the inspection zone for at least 1500 ms, with no explicitly stated stopped/still requirement, so max_speed is null.
Crossing into packing is left-to-right (+x) movement, which the provided line definition maps to direction 'to_left' on packing_entry.
No maximum time between the inspection dwell and the packing crossing is stated, so BEFORE uses within_ms null.
Boxes that never cross into packing pass, using the IMPLIES(OCCURS(B), BEFORE(A, B)) idiom.

texts.text: Every box must pause in the inspection zone for 1.5 seconds before entering packing.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry to the left must have first dwelled stopped in the inspection zone for at least 1500 ms.

assumptions: Pause interpreted as stopped dwell with max_speed 0.05.
1.5 seconds interpreted as 1500 ms continuously inside the zone.
Entering packing interpreted as CROSSES packing_entry in direction to_left, which per provided mapping is rightwards (+x) travel left to right.
Boxes that never cross packing_entry pass vacuously.
No maximum time limit between pause and entry, so within_ms is null.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry to_left must first dwell stopped in inspection for at least 1500 ms.

assumptions: 'Pause' is interpreted as a continuous DWELL in the inspection zone with max_speed 0.05 (stopped/still).
1.5 seconds is converted to 1500 ms.
Entering packing is interpreted as crossing packing_entry in the boxes' left-to-right travel direction, which the given mapping labels as to_left (rightwards, +x).
No maximum interval between the pause and entering packing is specified, so BEFORE uses within_ms null.
Boxes that never enter packing pass, following the IMPLIES(OCCURS(entering), BEFORE(pause, entering)) idiom.

texts.text: Boxes must spend at least 1.5 seconds in the inspection zone before entering packing.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry to_left must have continuously dwelled in inspection for at least 1500 ms before that crossing.

assumptions: 1.5 seconds interpreted as 1500 ms continuous DWELL
Entering packing interpreted as CROSSES packing_entry in direction to_left (rightwards +x) per stated left-to-right travel
Spending time interpreted as presence with any motion (max_speed null), not requiring stopped
Boxes that never cross packing_entry pass vacuously
No maximum time limit between dwell and entry (within_ms null)

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry to_left must first have dwelled continuously in inspection for at least 1500 ms.

assumptions: Entering packing is interpreted as crossing line 'packing_entry' rightwards (+x, left-to-right), which the line definition maps to direction 'to_left'.
1.5 seconds is converted to 1500 ms.

'Spend at least 1.5 seconds in the inspection zone' is interpreted as one continuous DWELL in zone 'inspection' for at least 1500 ms, with max_speed null because the rule does not require boxes to be stopped.
No maximum interval between the inspection dwell and entering packing is specified, so BEFORE uses within_ms null.
Boxes that never enter packing pass the rule, using IMPLIES(OCCURS(crossing), BEFORE(dwell, crossing)).

texts.text: No box may enter packing without being held in the inspection zone for 1.5 seconds.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry must have previously dwelled stopped in the inspection zone for at least 1.5 seconds.

assumptions: 'enter packing' interpreted as CROSSES line 'packing_entry' in direction 'to_left', which is defined as moving rightwards (+x).
'held in the inspection zone for 1.5 seconds' interpreted as DWELL continuously inside zone 'inspection' for >=1500 ms while stopped (max_speed 0.05).
The inspection dwell must precede the packing-entry crossing, with no maximum time gap (within_ms null).

texts.text: Every box must be inspected for at least 1.5 seconds before it crosses into packing.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry must have continuously dwelled in inspection for at least 1500 ms before its first crossing.

assumptions: 1.5 seconds converted to 1500 ms continuous DWELL min_ms.
'inspected' interpreted as continuously inside zone 'inspection' with any motion allowed (max_speed null), as stopped/still not stated.
'crosses into packing' interpreted as CROSSES line 'packing_entry' in direction 'to_left', which per given mapping corresponds to rightward (+x) left-to-right travel.
No maximum time gap between inspection and crossing enforced (within_ms null); only ordering that inspection precedes first crossing is required.
Boxes that never cross packing_entry pass vacuously via IMPLIES idiom.

texts.text: Every box must remain at the inspection station for at least 1.5 seconds before packing.

rule.normalized_explanation: Every box that crosses packing_entry must have dwelled stopped in the inspection zone for at least 1500 ms beforehand.

assumptions: 'packing' interpreted as crossing line 'packing_entry' in normal travel direction (to_left = rightwards +x per mapping)
'remain at the inspection station' interpreted as DWELL continuously inside zone 'inspection'
'remain' interpreted as stopped/still, so max_speed 0.05
1.5 seconds interpreted as min_ms 1500
No maximum time limit between inspection dwell and packing, so within_ms null
Boxes that never cross packing_entry pass vacuously via IMPLIES

rule.normalized_explanation: A tracked **box** passes if it either never enters packing, or it has dwelled at the inspection station for at least **1.5 seconds** before entering packing.

assumptions: Entity is 'box'; each box is checked independently.
Packing is interpreted as crossing line 'packing_entry'.
Boxes travel left to right, i.e. rightwards (+x), which the line definition maps to direction 'to_left', so packing is CROSSES('packing_entry', 'to_left').

Remaining at the inspection station is interpreted as DWELL('inspection', 1500, null): continuously inside the zone for at least 1.5 s = 1500 ms, with max_speed null so any motion while inside counts and being stopped/still is not required.
No time limit between the dwell and the packing-entry crossing is specified, so BEFORE uses within_ms null.
Boxes that never cross 'packing_entry' pass, using IMPLIES(OCCURS(packing), BEFORE(dwell, packing)).
BEFORE encodes its operands in its first and then event fields, so it has no children.
